nodes.description: EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>uint256) holding all numeric bridge state (limits, counters, gas price).
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>address) holding validator, owner and fee manager addresses.
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>bool) holding initialization and signature flags.
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>bytes) holding stored messages and signatures.
Storage slot key keccak256('owner') used by Ownable to store the bridge owner.
Storage slot key keccak256('validatorContract') holding the IBridgeValidators implementation.
Storage slot key keccak256('feeManagerContract'), target of delegatecall/callcode fee logic.
Storage slot key keccak256('dailyLimit') for the home-side daily withdrawal limit.
Storage slot key keccak256('executionDailyLimit') for the foreign-side execution daily limit.
Storage slot key keccak256('decimalShift') for the cross-chain decimal shift.
Storage slot key keccak256('isInitialized') guarding one-time initialization.
External onlyValidator function counting affirmations for a foreign event and triggering onExecuteAffirmation when the threshold is reached.
External onlyValidator function collecting validator signatures for a home message; the recoverAddressFromSignedMessage ownership check is commented out.
Internal function enforcing limits, recording daily spend and calculating the home-side fee before emitting UserRequestForSignature.
External payable entry point that forwards the sender's native value to nativeTransfer.
External onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner function that recovers non-bridged ERC20 tokens held by the bridge.
Internal dispatcher choosing native or ERC20 claim path for a validated receiver.
Internal function that pushes the whole contract balance to the receiver via Address.safeSendValue.
Internal function reading the token balance and calling SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Library helper performing a low-level send and falling back to a selfdestruct Sacrifice contract on failure.
Internal function delegatecalling setHomeFee/setForeignFee on the fee manager; controllable delegatecall target.
External onlyOwner setter for the fee manager address; only checks that the new target is a contract.
External onlyOwner function updating the home fee through the fee manager delegatecall.
External onlyOwner function updating the foreign fee through the fee manager delegatecall.
Internal view function computing the fee via assembly callcode into an arbitrary implementation address.
Internal view function reading a fee value from the fee manager using assembly callcode.
Public view function returning now / 1 days, the timestamp-dependent basis of all daily limits.
Public view enforcing dailyLimit, maxPerTx and minPerTx for outgoing home transfers.
Public view enforcing executionDailyLimit and executionMaxPerTx for affirmations.
Internal function accumulating the daily spent counter in uintStorage using SafeMath.add.
External onlyOwner setter for the daily limit.
External onlyOwner setter for the per-transaction maximum.
External onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a new address.
Internal function writing the new owner into addressStorage[OWNER].
Public view returning the stored owner address; basis of the onlyOwner modifier.
Private pure function applying 10**shift multiplication or division to a value; branching arithmetic on an int256 shift.
Internal view converting a foreign amount to the home amount using the current decimal shift.
Internal view converting a home amount to the foreign amount using the negated decimal shift.
External initializer guarded by onlyRelevantSender that configures the plain bridge.
External initializer that additionally installs the fee manager and both fee values via delegatecall.
Internal function writing validator, limits, gas price, decimal shift and owner into eternal storage.
Internal callback executed when enough affirmations are collected; shifts the value, computes fees and sends native coins.
Internal callback executed when enough signatures are collected; parses the message and distributes the home fee.
Internal callback invoked when an affirmation is out of limits; simply reverts.
Library function decoding recipient, amount, tx hash and contract address from the message bytes using assembly mload.
Library function validating the 65-byte signature layout and recovering the signer with ecrecover.
Library function looping over required signatures, recovering and checking each validator with ecrecover.
Pure helper converting a uint256 to its decimal string representation for hashing.
Default payable fallback of HomeBridgeNativeToErc forwarding msg.sender into nativeTransfer.
AddressUtils helper using extcodesize to determine whether an address holds code.
Modifier requiring validatorContract().isValidator(msg.sender) to be true.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner().
SafeERC20 helper performing an external token transfer with return-data validation.
Public view forwarding requiredSignatures() to the validator contract.
Internal function delegatecalling the fee manager to distribute the affirmation fee.
Internal function delegatecalling the fee manager to distribute the signatures fee.
External caller identity used for every authorization decision and for signature bookkeeping.
Block timestamp (now) used by getCurrentDay to derive the daily-limit bucket.
Low-level address.send(_value) external value transfer performed inside Address.safeSendValue.
selfdestruct(_recipient) in the Sacrifice helper, force-sending value after a failed send.
delegatecall into the owner-controlled fee manager address executing code in the bridge storage context.
Assembly callcode into the fee manager implementation address with raw returndata handling.
ecrecover used to derive signer addresses from supplied signature components.
Assembly mload reading of raw message bytes at fixed offsets without bounds validation.
External call to validatorContract().isValidator used as the sole access-control oracle.
_receiver parameter of nativeTransfer, the home-side recipient.
recipient parameter of executeAffirmation, the address to unlock/mint to.
value parameter of executeAffirmation, the amount to unlock/mint.
transactionHash parameter of executeAffirmation, the foreign-side event reference.
_fee parameter of setHomeFee forwarded into the fee manager delegatecall.
_value parameter of _shiftUint, the amount to be scaled by pow(10,shift).
_to parameter of claimNativeCoins, the native coin receiver.
_feeManager parameter of setFeeManagerContract, the new delegatecall target.
Local holding the post-fee amount emitted or sent to the recipient.
Local holding the fee calculated by calculateFee and subtracted from the transfer value.
Local signature/affirmation counter incremented with an unchecked +1 and marked with the processed bit.
Local daily-limit projection computed with SafeMath.add in withinLimit.
Local storage index keccak256(hashMsg, signed - 1) used to store a signature.

edges.reason: onlyValidator decides authorization purely from msg.sender against the external validator contract.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner() to gate privileged setters.
executeAffirmation builds hashSender from msg.sender and is gated by onlyValidator.
submitSignature builds hashSender from msg.sender and is gated by onlyValidator.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner, so the caller identity selects the new owner.
claimTokens is gated by onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner resolving msg.sender against the proxy owner.
Fallback forwards msg.sender as the receiver of nativeTransfer.
Fallback invokes nativeTransfer(msg.sender) for plain native transfers.
relayTokens forwards the payable call into nativeTransfer.
getCurrentDay derives the limit bucket from block.timestamp, making limits miner-influenceable.
withinLimit reads totalSpentPerDay for the timestamp-derived day.
withinExecutionLimit reads totalExecutedPerDay for the timestamp-derived day.
addTotalSpentPerDay writes the counter keyed by the timestamp-derived day.
nativeTransfer requires withinLimit(msg.value) before accepting the transfer.
nativeTransfer records the spent amount per day after the limit check.
nativeTransfer computes the home fee through calculateFee when a fee manager is set.
nativeTransfer assigns msg.value into valueToTransfer.
calculateFee returns the fee amount used by the caller.
The computed fee is subtracted from valueToTransfer with SafeMath.sub.
onExecuteAffirmation pushes native value out through Address.safeSendValue.
safeSendValue executes address.send(_value), forwarding control to the recipient.
The external value transfer permits the recipient to re-enter executeAffirmation before accounting is finalized.
claimNativeCoins sends the whole balance to _to via safeSendValue before returning.
claimValues routes address(0) tokens to claimNativeCoins.
claimValues routes ERC20 tokens to claimErc20Tokens.
claimTokens is restricted to the upgradeability owner and delegates to claimValues.
safeTransfer performs an external token call whose implementation can call back into the bridge.
_setFee delegatecalls the fee manager with a fee-type selector, executing untrusted code on bridge storage.
The delegatecall target is read from FEE_MANAGER_CONTRACT, settable by the owner.
setHomeFee is onlyOwner and forwards into the delegatecall setter.
setForeignFee is onlyOwner and forwards into the delegatecall setter.
setFeeManagerContract writes the only partly validated fee manager address into storage.
setFeeManagerContract validates the new target only with AddressUtils.isContract.
_getFee reads the fee through an assembly callcode into the fee manager.
calculateFee performs an assembly callcode into the supplied implementation address.
The callcode implementation is taken from the stored fee manager contract.
recoverAddressFromSignedMessage derives the signer with ecrecover over the hashed message.
hasEnoughValidSignatures recovers each validator address with ecrecover in a loop.
hasEnoughValidSignatures requires each recovered address to satisfy isValidator.
onlyValidator relies on the external isValidator view call as the access oracle.
The isValidator call targets the contract stored under VALIDATOR_CONTRACT.
submitSignature no longer verifies the signer: the recoverAddressFromSignedMessage check is commented out.
executeAffirmation is restricted to a single validator per affirmation by onlyValidator.
submitSignature is restricted by onlyValidator while the signature check is disabled.
parseMessage reads recipient/value/hash/contract from raw bytes at fixed offsets.
onSignaturesCollected decodes the collected message before fee distribution.
onSignaturesCollected computes the home fee from the parsed amount.
onSignaturesCollected distributes the signatures fee.
onExecuteAffirmation distributes the affirmation fee before sending value.
distributeFeeFromSignatures delegatecalls the fee manager with untrusted code.
distributeFeeFromAffirmation delegatecalls the fee manager with untrusted code.
onExecuteAffirmation scales the affirmed value with _shiftValue before sending.
initialize is onlyRelevantSender and performs the privileged storage configuration.
rewardableInitialize is onlyRelevantSender and reuses the same initializer path.
rewardableInitialize writes the fee manager address directly into storage.
_initialize sets the initial owner without an existence check on the caller.
_setOwner writes the new owner into addressStorage[OWNER].
owner() reads the OWNER storage slot consumed by the access modifiers.
setDailyLimit is onlyOwner and writes the DAILY_LIMIT slot controlling fund outflow.
_shiftValue multiplies the value by 10**decimalShift.
_unshiftValue divides the value by 10**decimalShift.
The _value parameter is scaled by pow(10,shift) inside _shiftUint.
executeAffirmation increments the signed counter with an unchecked +1 protected only by the processed bit.
withinLimit projects the daily spend with SafeMath.add into nextLimit.
submitSignature computes signIdx as signed - 1 to key stored signatures.

normalization_plan.reason: _receiver is only used as the recipient argument of nativeTransfer and carries no independent semantics.
recipient flows directly from executeAffirmation into the native value send performed by onExecuteAffirmation.
value is the affirmation amount consumed by onExecuteAffirmation for limit and fee accounting.
transactionHash is only used to build the message hash and emit the affirmation event.
_fee is forwarded unchanged into the owner-only fee setter flow.
_value is the sole numeric input of the private shifting routine.
_to is validated by validAddress and then used as the native receiver.
_feeManager becomes the delegatecall/callcode target stored in FEE_MANAGER_CONTRACT.
valueToTransfer is a short-lived staging variable for the emitted transfer amount.
fee is purely the result of calculateFee and is subtracted immediately.
signed is the local mirror of numAffirmationsSigned used for the threshold comparison.
nextLimit is a temporary projection of the daily spend used by the limit predicate.
signIdx is an ephemeral storage index derived from the signature counter.
